description: Changes a wishlist's title, who it is for (recipient) and the day of the occasion (occasion_date, YYYY-MM-DD, today or later), given its edit link or the token at the end of it. Only the fields given are changed; clear_recipient and clear_occasion_date empty those two. The products on the list are not touched. Returns the list as it is now. The token stops working once the list has been saved to a Plendio account.

clear_occasion_date.description: True to remove the occasion date.

edit_token.description: The wishlist's edit link as returned when it was created, or just the token at the end of it.

market.description: Market for the urls in the answer: dk, se, de or no. Default: the market the list was made for.

occasion_date.description: The day of the occasion as YYYY-MM-DD, today or later.

recipient.description: Who the list is for. Up to 80 characters; markup and links are removed.

title.description: New name of the list. Up to 80 characters; markup and links are removed.

name: update_wishlist

available.description: False for a product that has left the catalogue or has no offer now.

note.description: Text written by whoever made the list.

price_from.description: Cheapest current price in the catalogue, in major units of currency; absent when no shop lists one.

url.description: The product's page on Plendio, listing all its offers.

recipient.description: Who the list is for, written by whoever made it.

share_url.description: The list's page on Plendio, read-only.

title.description: The list's name, written by whoever made it.

total_from.description: Sum of price_from over the available items; absent when their currencies differ or none has a price.

title: Update a wishlist's details
